annotations.text: Desktop mockups at 1440 wide, following docs/06-thread-views.md and docs/07-api-and-clients.md. Tokens and type match the design overview page. The thread page shows page 3 of a 212-post thread: a moderator post, a reply expander, a tombstone, the unread divider, a reply-to indicator with quote, an attachment, and the composer with a reply-to chip.

Mobile at 390 wide. Bottom tab bar carries the cross-forum lists (Forums, Unread, New, Alerts, Me); compose is a floating button on list screens and a sticky reply bar on the thread page. Same tokens, 44 px minimum targets, one column, no nesting. Long pages scroll; the frames are tall so the whole screen is visible here.
